WITH q3_paid AS (
  SELECT o.id, c.region
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    AND o.placed_at >= '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z' AND o.placed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
),
gross AS (
  SELECT q.region, SUM(l.qty * l.unit_cents) AS cents
  FROM q3_paid q JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = q.id
  GROUP BY q.region
),
refunded AS (
  SELECT q.region, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS cents
  FROM q3_paid q JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = q.id
  GROUP BY q.region
)
SELECT g.region, g.cents - COALESCE(r.cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents
FROM gross g LEFT JOIN refunded r ON r.region = g.region
ORDER BY net_revenue_cents DESC
